description: 한국식품안전관리인증원_태양광 발전설비 일일 발전량 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국식품안전관리인증원. ESG 경영 추진과 기후변화 대응및 탄소 감축을 위한 재생에너지 발전 확대 추진에 따라 한국식품안전관리인증원 청주 본원에 설치된 태양광 발전설비의 일일 발전량(Kwh) 및 주소(도로명. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국식품안전관리인증원. Its tags are 한국식품안전관리인증원, 태양광 발전, ESG, 재생에너지, 친환경. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
